title: What Turkey Is Committing To In Its Defense Pact With Saudi Arabia And Pakistan
summary: Turkey's vote on the Mecca Pact with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan sends no troops. Gaps on budget, forces and terrorism leave the harder choices for later votes.
